faculty_override_note: The official 2025-2026 two-year map is the planning default. DegreeWorks and Business Management faculty advisement remain authoritative.
sequence_notes: MAT 206 is strongly recommended for Mathematical and Quantitative Reasoning and is the course shown on the official map; the full approved Pathways pool remains selectable.
MAT 206 or MAT 206.5 must be completed before MAT 301.
FNB 100 and ACC 122 must be completed before FNB 230 and FNB 300.
ECO 202 is strongly recommended for Individual and Society, and ECO 201 is strongly recommended for U.S. Experience in Its Diversity.
The General Elective requirement is five credits. Common Core STEM excess credit may satisfy part of it; MAT 209, ACC 222, or CIS 200 is recommended.
The cross-Flexible-Core limit of no more than two courses in one discipline is published but is not enforced by the current cross-group rule engine.
A Writing Intensive course is required for graduation.
